Maya (CS): FYI NimbusBank pilot — 24w usage collapsed ~78% last 2 weeks, new CISO onboarded, procurement asked about a competitor PoC. Need triage.
Sam (AE): Ugh. Do we have a root cause yet? errors or just stopped calling?
Maya (CS): No errors in Sentry, traffic just dropped. Top endpoints: embeddings and rerank. I pulled token counts: last active 2026-03-10, avg tokens/day down from 120k->25k.
Leo (Solutions Eng): I can run a live check on their route. Can you share the account id? Also any config changes/keys rotated?
Maya (CS): Account ID: nb-9432. No key rotations recorded. They did mention a security review last week — CISO likely paused integrations.
Ruben (Support Eng): Quick check in infra: their last successful call 2026-03-10 18:11 UTC. No 5xx spikes. Redirects look fine. Might be org-level policy blocking calls.
Sam (AE): Sales reached out? If CISO paused, procurement will be in loop. We should propose a short security review pack and a non-prod smoke demo.
Maya (CS): I'll prep security docs and ask for the CISO's risk checklist. Need a short playbook: 30m security sync, propose Dedicated trial, offer SAML & KMS notes.
Leo (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a minimal dedicated config and suggest IP allowlist steps. Also can run a quick canary with obfuscated PII to show throughput.
Sam (AE): I'll ping procurement and flag renewal risk — remind them of contract window in 6w. Offer a one-week dedicated trial as bridge.
Maya (CS): Can everyone drop any customer-visible collateral links here? ops-bot:link please.
ops-bot: https://redwood.internal/docs/security-pack.pdf
Leo (Solutions Eng): Adding checklist snippet:
```
1) IP allowlist
2) SAML metadata exchange
3) KMS envelope key flow
4) Audit log retention settings
```
Maya (CS): Ok plan: (1) Maya send security pack to CISO today, (2) Sam to ask procurement if trial helps, (3) Leo to prepare canary config by EOD, (4) Ruben to monitor for any new errors. I'll schedule 30m call if they accept. Any other blockers?
Ruben (Support Eng): +1. If they ask for logs, share rate-limited excerpts only. Also watch for a competitor PoC — ask for pilot scope.
Sam (AE): Got it. I'll offer a parallel sandbox PoC to the CISO to keep them engaged. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update thread after first reply from CISO. :calendar:
